questions.title: Which connectivity patterns best predict episodic migraine severity?
How do psychological interventions interact with sensory load and fatigue?
Why can a syncope patient look stable and still carry a high-risk ECG signal?

projects.title: Nature Migraine Research
projects.problem: Nature-portfolio papers on intervention, connectivity, sensory load, and models arrive faster than they can be thought through.
projects.approach: Keep papers as resources. Promote concepts only when evidence accumulates. Let questions drive the agenda.

projects.title: AI Agents Reading

projects.approach: Resources stay in the lake. Concepts are promoted only when a pattern looks durable.

observatory.title: Apparent stability, ST elevation
observatory.description: A patient can look well after a brief syncope-like episode and still present widespread ST elevation. The work is risk stratification, not an immediate label.

observatory.title: Distant reading as a trigger
observatory.description: A system idea arrived while reading Bolaño, not while designing the vault. Distant material can reorganize thinking without being filed as a fact.
